name: Corn
description: A fat ear of golden corn, its husk pulled back. Eat it for a little health. Tame Grazers eat it from their Feeding Trough like carrots, and the Fabricator makes Poppers from it. It grows wild in fields and meadows: break a corn plant with the Sledgehammer (or a creation's saw) for 3 or 4 ears; it grows back. Flammable.
